This ensures that each test suite runs independently without interference from detached worktrees, which can lead to redundant or conflicting test outcomes. The operator's breakdown regime occurs when exclusion sets become insufficient, leading to test duplication or false positives. The derived kernel 'ci_failure_analysis' identifies root causes of build failures—specifically, missing binaries and broken symbolic links—which act as failure gates in the pipeline. These failures propagate through the system unless corrected via configuration updates. The intelligence target verification function maps test results to predefined intelligence categories (props, sgp, etc.), enabling structured validation of system behavior. Together, these primitives form a closed-loop verification system where each component contributes to a robust, self-monitoring CI environment.
